book.name: Yohana
book.title: Cau amsǝban a nê mala YOHANA

content: Amǝ'eam Yesu earnǝi ɗang
Anzǝm man ngga, Yesu gya aɓa nzali Galili; eare kutio aɓa bu-nzali Yahudi ɗang, acemǝnana aɓwana-mǝgule mala amǝ Yahudi mǝnana akanó ka, à nda ban alte à nǝ̀ wal-luí.
Sǝ lang Lamsan Do aɓalǝ Agumli, mala amǝ Yahudi gbashìnà ka,
amǝ'eam Yesu ne wi ama, <<Kyane a bu-nzali Yahudi, ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ alaggana mò ɓǝà kya sǝn agir-ndali mǝnana a kǝ pea ka.
Kǝɓwa pà kàm mǝnana kǝ earce ɓǝ̀ aɓwana súrǝì, sǝ nǝ̀ nggǝ pakki atúró aɓa sǝmbǝrǝa ka ɗàng. Sǝ acemǝnana a kǝ pakki amǝnia yì agir ka, puro lǝmdǝ rǝò ɓǝ̀ ɓanza súrǝ̀o.>>
Nggearǝ amǝ'eam Yesu nǝ ɓamuria ka, à earnǝi à paɓamuria a baní ɗàng.
Pǝlǝa Yesu nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Pwari mem mǝnana mǝ nǝ pur nǝi a banfana ka, malaká karǝ peatu ɗàng, sǝ ma'wun ngga koya pwari ka ma'wun na.
Ɓanza pa nǝ ɓinǝ mǝsǝ wun ɗàng, sǝ mim ngga kǝ ɓinǝ mǝsǝam, acemǝnana ǝn nggǝ bang aɓealɓikea mǝnana kǝ pak ka.
Wu kyane. Mim ngga pà mǝ nǝ ká ado ɗàng, acemǝnana pwari mem malaká karǝ ɗang.>>

content: Anzǝm mǝnana Yesu bangŋǝnia wia cau anggo ka, pǝlǝa akrǝi zuku a Galili.
Yesu wari a ban Lamsanmala Do aɓalǝ Agumli
Anzǝm mǝnana amǝ'eambi umna a ban Lamsan ka, Yesu gbal ka wari ɗǝong, pusǝrǝi ɗàng.
Aɓwana-mǝgule mala amǝ Yahudi camarǝ alte a ban Lamsan, à kǝ ɗikiban ama, <<Ɓwe nda ake le?>>
Aɓwabundǝa kǝ nacau nggùr-nggùr amur Yesu. Aɓea ɓwana ama, <<Yì ka, ɓwa mǝɓoarne na.>> Sǝ aɓea ɓwana gbal ka ama, <<Awo, yì ka, mǝ'swarkiban na.>>
Sǝ kǝɓwa puro nacau bwāng amurí ɗàng, acemǝnana à kǝ ɓanggi aɓwana-mǝgule mala amǝ Yahudi.
Lang à warina ɗār aɓa Lamsan, à gauwuni a tsùrú ka, Yesu kutio aɓa Ndàmǝgule mala Ɓakuli, pǝlǝa tita kani aɓwana gìr.
Sǝ aɓwana-mǝgule mala amǝ Yahudi ka à ndali kǝ̀rkǝ́r, à na ama, <<Lang sǝ ɓwa man súrǝ̀ gir ani kǝ̀rkǝ́r, yi mǝnana kǝɓwa kani wi raka?>>
Pǝlǝa Yesu nea wia ama:

content.text: Agir mǝnana ǝn nggǝ kania wun ngga à mem na ɗang, à puro a ban Ɓakuli mǝnana tasǝam ngga.
Ɓwa mǝnana kat earǝna ama nǝ̀ pak gìr mǝnana Ɓakuli earkiyi ce ka, nǝ̀ sǝlǝa ko kanigir mem ngga pur nǝ ban Ɓakuli, ko mala ɓamur rǝàm nda ǝn nggǝ na ka.
Ɓwa mǝnana kǝ nacau aɓa ɓamur rǝì ka, gulo mala ɓamur rǝì nda alkiyite ka, sǝ ɓwa mǝnana kǝ pak gìr ace gulo mala ɓwa mǝnana túrí ka, ɓwa mǝ'mǝsǝcau nì na, ɓe kǝgìr nyir pa a ɓālǝi ɗàng.
Musa nǝ̀ pà wun Nggurcau re? Sǝ kǝɓwa atà wun kpate ɗàng. Ace mana sǝ wu kǝ earce ama wun nǝ̀ wal-luem?

content: Ɓwabunda mǝnana ram ngga ne wi ama, <<We ka, kukwar na a rǝò. Yana alkiyito ama nǝ̀ wal-luio?>>
Pǝlǝa Yesu earia wia ama,

content.text: <<Ən pak gir'ndǝlǝki mwashat ɓǝ̀rɓǝ̀r a pwari Sabbat, sǝ wun kat ka wu pak ndali.
Musa pà wun Nggurcau mala kasǝ-ɓatau, kat andǝ amani ama yì nǝ̀ tite raka, aká wun nǝ̀ tite. Ace mani ka wu kǝ kasǝi muna ɓate a pwari Sabbat, pwari usǝlǝo.

Ɓǝ̀ pwari mana à tsǝa ace kasǝî muna-ɓwabura ɓate, kpa a pwari Sabbat, pwari usǝlǝo ka, wu kǝ lidǝmba nǝ pe, ace mǝnana ɓǝà kǝa yàl Nggurcau mala Musa raka. Palang sǝ bum wun lúllô a rǝàm acemǝnana ǝn twali ɓwa ban rǝkwana a pwari Sabbat ka?
Wu kǝa wu pak ɓashi ace sǝn ɓamǝsǝu ɗang. Wu pak ɓashi amur gìr mǝnana mǝsǝcau na ka.>>

content: Yesu ka, nda Kǝrǝsti, Mǝ'amsǝban le?
Pǝlǝa aɓea amǝ Urǝshalima na ama, <<Nggearǝ ɓwa mǝnia nda mbak aɓwana-mǝgule mala amǝ Yahudi alkiyite ama à nǝ̀ wal-luí ka re?
Sǝ ndya came kǝ nacau a banfana ka, sǝ kǝɓwa loasǝ kun arǝì ɗàng. Ko aɓwana-mǝgule ka, à earǝna adyan ama mǝsǝcau yì ka, nda Kǝrǝsti, yì ɓwa mǝnana Ɓakuli tarrì ka le?
Màlà mǝnia yì ɓwa ka sǝm sùrǝ́nà rǝ ban mǝnana pur kàm ngga. Sǝ ɓǝ̀ Kǝrǝsti yiu ka, kǝɓwa pà nǝ̀ súrǝ̀ ban mǝnana pur kàm ngga ɗàng.>>
Mǝnana Yesu nda ban kanigìr aɓa Ndàmǝgule mala Ɓakuli ka, loasǝ gi kpǝm na ama,

content.text: <<Kàngkàng wu súrǝàm andǝ ban mǝnana ǝn pur kàm ngga? Mim ngga ǝn yiu ace cau mala ɓamur rǝàm ɗàng. Tárrám mǝnana tasǝam ngga mǝ'mǝsǝcau na. Wun ngga wu súrǝì ɗàng.
Mim ngga ǝn súrǝì, acemǝnana a baní sǝ ǝn puro, sǝ yì nǝ̀ túrǎm.>>

content: Lang Yesu bangŋǝna cau man anggo ka, aɓwana-mǝgule mala amǝ Yahudi ɓariki ama à nǝ̀ bwali, sǝ kǝɓwa tsǝk bu arǝì ɗàng, acemǝnana pwari male malaká pak ɗàng.

Sǝ aɓa mǝno anggo kat ka aɓwana pas aɓalǝ aɓwana mǝnana à ram ngga à pà ɓamuria a ban Yesu. À kǝ na ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ Kǝrǝsti, yì ɓwa mǝnana Ɓakuli tarrì, yiu ka, nǝ̀ yia pakki agir-ndǝlǝki mǝnana à kútì mana mǝnia yì ɓwa ka pakkia ka le?>>
À tasǝ amǝ yálban ɓǝàkya bwal Yesu
Amǝ Farisi ok ɓwabundǝa aban sherǝ amǝnia yì acau ka amur Yesu, pǝlǝa yia andǝ agbani pǝris tasǝ amǝ'yál Ndàmǝgule mala Ɓakuli ama ɓǝà kya bwali.
Yesu nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Mǝ ndakani ado atà wun zuku, sǝ mǝ nǝ nyare mǝ nǝ o a ban Tárrám mǝnana tasǝam ngga.
Wun nǝ̀ altam, sǝ pa wu nǝ̀ kumam ɗang; sǝ ban mǝnana mǝ ndakam ngga pa wu nǝ̀ gandǝ ká kàm ɗàng.>>

content: Sǝ aɓwana-mǝgule mala amǝ Yahudi nacau arǝarǝia ama, <<Nggearǝì ka, ake sǝ nǝ̀ ká le, mǝnana pà sǝm nǝ̀ sǝni raka? Ko nǝ̀ ká a ban aɓwana ma'sǝm mǝnana à mesǝkea arǝ alá mala amǝ Gǝrik ka, sǝ nǝ̀ nggá kània amǝ Gǝrik agir gbal le?
Sǝ ɓālǝi aman, yi mǝnana na ama, sǝm nǝ̀ alte sǝ pà sǝm nǝ̀ kumi ɗàng; sǝ ɗǝm ngga na ama, ban mǝnana ndakam ngga pà sǝm nǝ̀ gandǝ ká kàm ɗàng?>>
Mùr mǝnana kǝ pa yilǝmu ka
A masǝlǝata pwari, mǝnana ndà pwari mǝgule mala Lamsan ngga, Yesu lo came sǝ loasǝ gì kpǝm na ama,

content.text: <<Ɓwa mǝnana kat kǝ ok mǝsamur ka ɓǝ̀ yiu a banam ɓǝ̀ yi nu.
Ɓwa mǝnana kat pà ɓamur rǝì a banam ngga, a bumi sǝ amealmur mala mùr mǝpà yilǝmu nǝ̀ puro, à nǝ̀ nggǝ ɓangŋa, kǝla mǝnana Malǝmce na ka.>>

content: Yesu ndaban nacau amur kǝ Bangŋo mǝnana aɓwana mana à pà ɓamuria a baní ka, à nǝ̀ nggá kum ngga. Sǝ a pwari mǝno gbal anggo ka à malaká pà Bangŋo nì ɗàng, acemǝnana Yesu malaká loapi ɓembe kutia aɓa gulo male peatu raka.
Kun aɓwana gaki amur Yesu
Lang à nǝ̀ ok cau mǝnana Yesu na ka, aɓea ɓwana na ama, <<Mǝsǝcau na, mǝnia yì ɓwa ka nda Mǝɓangnǝa mala Ɓakuli mǝnana sǝm kundǝkiyi ka.>>
Sǝ aɓea ɓwana na ama, <<Kǝ yì nda Kǝrǝsti, Mǝ'amsǝban.>> Aɓea ɓwana bang ama, <<Palang sǝ Kǝrǝsti ka nǝ̀ pur a Galili?
Malǝmce na ama, Kǝrǝsti Mǝ'amsǝban ngga nǝ̀ pur a tàu mala Dauda, sǝ à nǝ̀ ɓǝli a Betalami, la mǝnana Dauda dukam ngga.>>
Kara kun aɓwana gakina amur Yesu.
Aɓea aɓwana ka eare malea ka à nǝ̀ bwal Yesu, sǝ kǝɓwa gandǝ tsǝk bu arǝì ɗàng.
Ɗwanyi pa ɓamuru mala aɓwanamǝgule mala amǝ Yahudi
Sǝ lang amǝ'yál Ndàmǝgule nyarǝna ka, agbani pǝris andǝ amǝ Farisi ɗia ama, <<Palang sǝ wu bwali wu yinǝi ɗàng?>>
Amǝ'yálban banggia wia ama, <<Kǝɓwa pà kàm mǝnana kǝ nacau kǝla mala mǝnia yì ɓwa ka ɗàng.>>
Sǝ amǝ Farisi pǝlǝa à nea wia ama, <<Wun gbal ka yi ɓosǝkina ta kun wun le?
Wu ok àkǝ̀ pwari ama kǝɓwa aɓalǝ aɓwana-mǝgule mala amǝ Yahudi ko amǝ Farisi, pà ɓamúrì a baní le?
Sǝ ɓwabundǝa mǝnia à kǝ gyate ka, à súrǝ̀ Nzongcau mala Musa raka, à nda a ɓata súban mala Ɓakuli!>>
Nikodimus ndakam a banì. Yì ka, nda aɓalǝ amǝ Farisi, amǝ kùrcau, sǝ nda ɓwamǝgule mǝnana wari a ban Yesu ɗiɗyal ka. Ɗiban ama,
<<Nggearǝì ka, Nggurcau ma'sǝm eara sǝm ama ɓǝ̀ sǝm kasǝ ɓashi amur ɓwa mǝnana à ok kǝcau a kúni, sǝ sǝm súrǝ̀ gir mǝnana pàk la raka le?>>
Sǝ à pe wi eare ama, <<Tino, we gbal ka a pur nǝ Galili le? Kyane kya bǝlki ɓá Malǝmce ɓukɓuk sǝ awu nǝ sǝlǝ ama kǝ mǝɓangnǝa pa nǝ̀ pur a Galili ɗàng.>>
[Sǝ koyan le ka nyare o a ɓala male.

footnotes.text: Ɓalli cê aɓa: Pur 23:16; Pǝris 23:34; Nggur 16:13.
